question: The ratio of the number of games won to the number of games lost (no ties) by the Middle School Middies is \(\frac{11}{4}.\) To the nearest whole percent, what percent of its games did the team lose?
solution:
The ratio gives \(11\) parts wins for every \(4\) parts losses. Since there are no ties, all games together make \(11+4=15\) equal ratio parts, of which \(4\) are losses.

Thus the percentage of games lost is
\[
\frac4{15}\cdot100\%=26.666\ldots\%.
\]
Rounding to the nearest whole percent gives \(27\%\), choice \(\text{B}\).
